summary: Style found two minor wording nits in ofTupleFromSeq's doc; accuracy review returned no findings; no blockers remain.

resolved_items.instruction: Drop the trailing period from the summary sentence to match the punctuation-free openings of the adjacent ofSeq and ofList doc comments.

Reword "Sequences of up to 22 elements are built with the corresponding `TupleN` constructor, longer ones with `Tuple.fromIArray`" to "Non-empty sequences of up to 22 elements are built with the corresponding `TupleN` constructor, longer ones with `Tuple.fromIArray`" since the 0-element case does not go through any TupleN helper.
